panels.title: Cumulative Tokens Saved (All Time)
panels.description: From usage_events: billable requests (an admin acting as a tenant, and error rows, are not counted).

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(tokens_saved) FROM usage_events WHERE COALESCE(billable, true) AND ('${tenant}' = '.*' OR tenant_id = '${tenant}') AND ('${team}' = '.*' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(team, ''), 'default') = '${team}') AND ('${user_id}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${user_id}')

panels.title: Cumulative Cost Saved (All Time, USD)
panels.description: From usage_events: billable requests (an admin acting as a tenant, and error rows, are not counted). Cost saved includes the estimated input cost a cache hit avoided.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(cost_saved_usd), 2) FROM usage_events WHERE COALESCE(billable, true) AND ('${tenant}' = '.*' OR tenant_id = '${tenant}') AND ('${team}' = '.*' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(team, ''), 'default') = '${team}') AND ('${user_id}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${user_id}')

panels.title: Avg Saving % (All Time)
panels.description: From usage_events: billable requests (an admin acting as a tenant, and error rows, are not counted).

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN baseline_tokens = 0 THEN 0 ELSE tokens_saved * 100.0 / baseline_tokens END)::numeric, 1) FROM usage_events WHERE COALESCE(billable, true) AND ('${tenant}' = '.*' OR tenant_id = '${tenant}') AND ('${team}' = '.*' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(team, ''), 'default') = '${team}') AND ('${user_id}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${user_id}')

panels.title: Total LLM Calls (All Time)
panels.description: From usage_events: billable requests (an admin acting as a tenant, and error rows, are not counted).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM usage_events WHERE COALESCE(billable, true) AND ('${tenant}' = '.*' OR tenant_id = '${tenant}') AND ('${team}' = '.*' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(team, ''), 'default') = '${team}') AND ('${user_id}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${user_id}')

panels.title: Quarterly Cumulative Cost Saved
panels.description: From usage_events: billable requests (an admin acting as a tenant, and error rows, are not counted). Cost saved includes the estimated input cost a cache hit avoided.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('quarter', timestamp) AS time, SUM(SUM(cost_saved_usd)) OVER (ORDER BY date_trunc('quarter', timestamp)) AS cumulative_cost_saved FROM usage_events WHERE COALESCE(billable, true) AND ('${tenant}' = '.*' OR tenant_id = '${tenant}') AND ('${team}' = '.*' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(team, ''), 'default') = '${team}') AND ('${user_id}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${user_id}') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: G-Group ROI Ranking (All Time)
panels.description: From usage_events: billable requests (an admin acting as a tenant, and error rows, are not counted). Only groups that saved tokens are listed: one that added tokens (e.g. retrieval context) is left out, though the request totals still count it.

targets.rawSql: SELECT key AS g_group, SUM(value::int) AS total_tokens_saved FROM usage_events, jsonb_each_text(group_savings) WHERE COALESCE(billable, true) AND ('${tenant}' = '.*' OR tenant_id = '${tenant}') AND ('${team}' = '.*' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(team, ''), 'default') = '${team}') AND ('${user_id}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${user_id}') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total_tokens_saved DESC

panels.title: Quarterly Cost by User (Stacked)
panels.description: From usage_events: billable requests (an admin acting as a tenant, and error rows, are not counted). Cost saved includes the estimated input cost a cache hit avoided.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('quarter', timestamp), 'YYYY-"Q"Q') AS quarter, user_id, ROUND(SUM(cost_saved_usd), 2) AS cost_saved_usd FROM usage_events WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 year' AND COALESCE(billable, true) AND ('${tenant}' = '.*' OR tenant_id = '${tenant}') AND ('${team}' = '.*' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(team, ''), 'default') = '${team}') GROUP BY date_trunc('quarter', timestamp), 1, 2 ORDER BY date_trunc('quarter', timestamp), cost_saved_usd DESC

panels.title: Quarterly Summary
panels.description: From usage_events: billable requests (an admin acting as a tenant, and error rows, are not counted). Cost saved includes the estimated input cost a cache hit avoided.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('quarter', timestamp), 'YYYY-"Q"Q') AS quarter, COUNT(*) AS total_calls, SUM(tokens_saved) AS tokens_saved, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN baseline_tokens = 0 THEN 0 ELSE tokens_saved * 100.0 / baseline_tokens END)::numeric, 1) AS avg_pct_saving, ROUND(SUM(cost_saved_usd), 2) AS cost_saved_usd, COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(user_id, '')) AS unique_users FROM usage_events WHERE COALESCE(billable, true) AND ('${tenant}' = '.*' OR tenant_id = '${tenant}') AND ('${team}' = '.*' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(team, ''), 'default') = '${team}') AND ('${user_id}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${user_id}') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC

list.name: user_id
list.label: User
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM usage_events WHERE user_id <> '' ORDER BY 1

list.name: team
list.label: Team
list.description: The authenticated team (usage_events.team; 'default' = no team, which also covers rows written before teams existed). Filters every panel that reads usage_events; Prometheus panels are not filtered by team.
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(team, ''), 'default') AS team FROM usage_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${tenant}' = '.*' OR tenant_id = '${tenant}') ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(team, ''), 'default') AS team FROM usage_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${tenant}' = '.*' OR tenant_id = '${tenant}') ORDER BY 1
